{{Top}}
{{Quote|Sarlaccs where extremely long-lived (20,000-50,000 years) and very rare giant arthropods who primary function is digestion.|[[Lyrre T'enna]] in her [[Lyrre T'enna's annotated field guide|annotated field guide]]|<ref name="Wildlife">''[[The Wildlife of Star Wars: A Field Guide]]''</ref>}}
[[File:Acklay-JTS.png|thumb|right|250px|[[Acklay/Legends|Acklays]] were large carnivorous arthropods.]]
'''Arthropods''' were a group of living creatures. [[Insect/Legends|Insects]] and insectoid [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]] were arthropods.<ref name="Dark Nest I: The Joiner King">''[[Dark Nest I: The Joiner King]]'', Chapter 8.</ref> The [[Croke]] may have been arthropods.<ref name="The Essential Atlas">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> The [[Sarlacc/Legends|sarlacc]] were a species of extremely rare giant arthropods.<ref name="Wildlife" />
